svg.title: Neck, skin ramp 5, three-quarter view facing right. A CYLINDER, not a rectangle: the base and the leading edge carry the ramp's shade and the trailing edge its light, so the column turns even at phone size. It is its OWN PART, drawn below the torso and above nothing, so the coat collar closes over its base and the head closes over its top - which is what makes the head read as turning on a neck instead of sitting on the shoulders. Length is measured, not chosen: art-bible.md 7.3.
